messages.subject: Time recording — October WIP and narratives outstanding
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi all,

A reminder that October time entries and narratives are due by the 5th working day of November. Several matters currently show gaps for the week commencing 13 October. Please ensure narratives are client-ready (no internal shorthand) as we have a number of bills going out at month end.

Thanks,
Accounts
